main.description: Recipient-scoped sequence notices. The service-auth JWT never goes in the URL, because URLs land in logs. The client's first frame is #auth { token }; the server closes the socket if it does not arrive within 5 seconds. Notices carry { seq } only, never sender or content. A newer lease generation closes older sockets. Use list with exclusive afterSeq as the catch-up path. After successful #auth the server sends one #notice carrying the current watermark; this is the ready barrier, and clients list only after it.

auth.description: First client frame carries a fresh service-auth JWT, never a URL parameter.
